title: Release scripts exit 0 having done nothing when invoked through a symlinked path (entry-point guard compares unresolved argv[1])
description:
Found 2026-09-28 while building QCLI-402's end-to-end test. The release scripts run main() only when `resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`. resolve() does not follow symlinks, but import.meta.url is the resolved module path. So invoking a script through a symlinked path (macOS tmpdir /var -> /private/var, or a symlinked checkout) makes the comparison false, and the script exits 0 with no output, having done nothing. Measured: promote-release.mjs copied under mkdtemp(tmpdir()) and run with --promote exited 0 with empty stderr and made zero gh or npm calls. Run through its realpath, the same copy refused with exit 1 as expected.

For a release script, a silent exit 0 is the worst outcome: a promotion that never ran reads as a promotion that succeeded. It is not a live risk today, because the runbook invokes the scripts from the checkout's real path, but nothing enforces that.

Files with this guard (grep at dev, 10): scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs scripts/check-lockfile-pins.mjs scripts/github-release.mjs scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs scripts/promote-release.mjs scripts/qualification/e2e-receipt.mjs scripts/qualification/version-parity.mjs scripts/publish-release.mjs scripts/qualification/bundle-integrity.mjs scripts/qualification/native-execution-receipt.mjs

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every script with the entry-point guard runs main() when invoked through a symlinked path to itself. The fix compares resolved real paths on both sides, or otherwise stops a symlinked invocation from exiting 0 having done nothing.

A test invokes at least promote-release.mjs through a symlink and shows it reaches main(): it refuses or proceeds as it would through the real path, and never exits 0 silently. The same test fails against the current guard.
The list of affected scripts is re-enumerated with grep when this is implemented, and the count is stated, rather than taken from the 10 in this description.

plan: 1. Re-enumerate the entry-point-guard files with grep at the worktree base and state the count (AC3).
2. Fix every guard to compare resolved real paths on both sides (realpathSync), so a symlinked invocation reaches main() (AC1).

3. Add a test that invokes promote-release.mjs through a symlink and proves main() is reached (refuses or proceeds as via the real path; never a silent exit 0), and show it fails against the current guard (AC2).
4. Run the repo checks with the pinned bun 1.4.2 (/opt/homebrew/bin/bun): bun run check plus the touched suites.
5. Land through the usual gates: feature branch from the prepared worktree, PR into dev, required checks green on the head, independent review, squash merge.

finalSummary:
QCLI-404: entry-point guards under scripts/ compared resolve(process.argv[1]) to fileURLToPath(import.meta.url). resolve() keeps a symlink in argv[1] while import.meta.url is the realpath, so a symlinked invocation exited 0 having done nothing — and for a release gate a silent exit 0 reads as success. All 11 broken sites now compare realpathSync on both sides (the form lore-pin-staleness.mjs already used); the 12th guard site, qualification/require-platform-visibility.mjs, had a bare comparison and was fixed the same way. The live count at f636c493 is 12 guard-carrying scripts, 11 broken, 1 already correct — the description said 10.

New test/qcli404-symlinked-entry-point.test.ts enumerates guard-carrying scripts from source, invokes each through an explicit symlink, and requires exit code, stdout and stderr identical to the real path, with a per-file positive control a silent run cannot satisfy vacuously, plus promote-release.mjs end-to-end through the qcli402 stub harness asserting the symlinked run equals the real run and writes no record.

Verified: red 0 pass / 2 fail against the unfixed base, measured independently twice; green 2 pass / 80 expect assertions after the fix; full bun run check green on pinned bun 1.4.2 (1076 tests, typecheck, lint, format, layer all clean); an independent reviewer confirmed all three criteria, with a mutation matrix that reddens on any single guard restored. Delivered on feat/QCLI-404-symlink-guard and landed into dev through the task PR; the transfer ran under the OPAG-995 canary with its evidence on this record and in the canary evidence directory.
